subject.title: Telegram: /commands in forum topics bypass groupPolicy disabled and trigger all bots

question: Should Telegram native slash commands inherit effective topic/group `groupPolicy` and silently drop commands in disabled forum topics for non-owning bot accounts?
rationale: This changes a Telegram command authorization boundary and prior fix attempts show that the exact disabled-topic response behavior needs maintainer acceptance before repair automation should proceed.

options.title: Sponsor a replacement fix
options.body: Accept the existing policy contract and ask for a narrow same-repo fix with silent disabled-topic drops, regression tests, and real Telegram proof.

options.title: Revive the fork branch after changes
options.body: Use the open fork PR only if it is updated to handle silent drops and proof rather than landing the one-line flag flip as-is.

options.title: Defer command-policy change
options.body: Keep native commands stricter or separate from normal message policy until maintainers design an explicit Telegram command policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a replacement fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing policy contract and ask for a narrow same-repo fix with silent disabled-topic drops, regression tests, and real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest recent same-path owner signal for Telegram native-command group authorization and merged adjacent group-auth work.
